subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should CodexBar make this model-activity and partial-coverage design the default Usage & Spend share card, replacing the existing provider/subscription-oriented presentation?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish a coherent technical path, but selecting the default social narrative and visible information hierarchy is an owner product decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Sponsor the redesigned default
options.body: Accept the model-activity share-card direction and merge after the current required checks complete.

options.title: Keep the current share narrative
options.body: Do not merge this redesign and retain the existing provider/subscription-oriented card while the broader artifact direction remains open.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the redesigned default
recommendation.body: Accept the model-activity share-card direction and merge after the current required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The owner has already supplied design and runtime-review context for this exact card and authored adjacent Usage & Spend contract work.
